description: MBL disorder degrades holographic force: analytic perturbation theory assessment for chi=3 16q MERA
note: Analytic confirmation from perturbation theory. Full GPU VQE (20 runs, ~9h) would provide definitive experimental confirmation.

W_0.2.perturbation_regime: strong (W > gap, perturbation theory breaks down)

W_0.5.perturbation_regime: MBL phase (W >> gap, completely wrong Hamiltonian)

key_reasoning: First-order disorder correction vanishes: <GS|sum_i h_i Z_i|GS> = 0 by Z2 symmetry at criticality
Second-order correction is extensive: Delta_E ~ -W^2 * N / Delta_gap, shifts Hamiltonian away from critical point
MERA optimized for clean critical Hamiltonian -- reoptimization needed for each disorder realization
Disorder breaks translation invariance: F(i,j) != F(|i-j|), making sigma profile ill-defined
MBL phase (W >> J) is incompatible with criticality: RTN (Liang paper) gain geometry FROM disorder; MERA loses it
refutation_condition: NOT MET: no mechanism for W=0.05J to reduce energy error below 0.15% without disorder resonance, which is not expected from perturbation theory
gpu_run_status: NOT_RUN (analytic confirmation sufficient; GPU ~9h run would provide definitive confirmation with actual VQE data)
gpu_recommendation: Queue as lower-priority overnight run if GPU available. Expected result: monotonic increase in energy error and dalpha with W.
mbl_liang_distinction: RTN (Liang PAPER-2026-042): disorder IS the geometry (random tensors define bulk). MERA: geometry from variational optimization of clean Hamiltonian. These are fundamentally different mechanisms. Liang's result does not transfer.
